assumptions: The vehicle starts with 50 gallons (100% of a 50-gallon tank); that fuel is not counted as a purchase, so trips within the starting range cost $0.00.
Fuel is bought only as needed to minimise cost; the vehicle may reach a stop or the destination with an empty tank, and never exceeds the 500-mile range between refuelling points.
Each station's price is the lowest price listed for it in the supplied dataset, treated as the current USD price per gallon.
Station coordinates are not in the dataset: they are the centroid of the station's city (location_precision "city"), so a station can be a few miles from its marker.
Only stations within 5 miles (straight line) of the route are considered. A detour is driven out and back, and the fuel it uses is paid for.
The start location was resolved to the city of 'Dallas, TX', not to an exact address.
The finish location was resolved to the city of 'Houston, TX', not to an exact address.
